description: Search upcoming crafting events on this site. Published, upcoming events with their next date in the window. Filters: q (full text with typo tolerance), craft/type/tag (comma lists of taxonomy slugs; a top-level craft also matches its child crafts, so needlework includes cross-stitch), state, when (weekend|next7|next30|next90|month:YYYY-MM) or from+to, near (a US place as 'City, ST', e.g. 'Columbus, OH', or 'all') or lat+lng, radius (25|50|100|250|any, default 100 with a location), free=1, online=1 (only online events; other values are ignored), inperson=1 (only in-person events, including multi-location; other values are ignored; online=1 and inperson=1 together cancel out to no format filter, rather than matching nothing), sort (date|distance|relevance; default best match for q, else soonest first; distance needs a location, and without one falls back to that default), tz (IANA, for date presets). Invalid filter values are ignored, except a near that matches no US place, which is a 400 validation_failed. With no state, near or lat+lng, a trailing US place in q, like 'quilt show Arizona' or 'Phoenix, AZ', sets the location: a state name or capitalized code becomes state and 'City, ST' becomes near (radius 50 unless given; a city that matches no place is retried on its last 2 words, then its last word, then falls back to its state), and the place is removed from the text query. Location is never inferred from the caller's IP. `featured` holds up to 3 featured events matching the same search; they are excluded from `items` on every page. featured=0 turns that off: no featured lookup, `featured` is empty and `items` leaves nothing out (for a client that shows its own results without a featured row).

featured.description: 0 skips the featured row: `featured` comes back empty and nothing is left out of `items`. Any other value is ignored.

name: list_events
